latest.title: Weightings and Lie groupoids
latest.abstract: This note originated with a mini-course taught at KU Leuven by the author in June 2026. We review the definition of weightings (or quasi-homogeneous structures), the weighted normal bundle, and the weighted deformation space. We emphasize the algebraic approach and functorial properties, using sheaves of ideals and the character spectrum for sheaves of algebras. We review the definition of a multiplicative weighting on a Lie groupoid $G\rightrightarrows M$, and give a self-contained proof of the three-way equivalence between (i) multiplicative weightings of $G$ along $M$, (ii) Lie filtrations of the Lie algebroid $A$ of $G$, (iii) dg weightings of the NQ manifold $A[1]$ along $M$. The corresponding weighted deformation space is a weighted variant of the tangent/adiabatic groupoid and is used in the study of hypoelliptic operators.
latest.workSummary: 综述加权结构、加权法丛与变形空间，并自洽证明 Lie 群胚乘法加权、Lie 代数胚过滤和 NQ 流形 dg 加权之间的三重等价。
latest.breakthrough: 以代数和函子方式统一三种加权语言，并把相应变形空间解释为切/绝热群胚的加权版本。
latest.limitations: 源自短课程的综述性笔记，主要结果重在重述和统一；对亚椭圆算子的具体新应用较少。
latest.aiEvidence: ChatGPT 用于终稿校对并发现少量错误与遗漏；作者承担剩余错误责任。
latest.priorityReason: 可作为群胚加权技术的入门资源，但原创突破和与当前曲率问题的直接联系有限。
